note: Strategy is not locked yet - these are discussion-stage values from the forward-test review sessions, not a committed production risk spec.

margin_cap_pct.note: Cap is on MARGIN USED (position_notional / leverage), NOT on notional directly. A prior internal simulation this session mistakenly capped notional directly, which crushed effective risk far below intent given these symbols' tight ATR-based stops - corrected here. margin_used_cap = margin_cap_pct% of equity; allowed_notional = margin_used_cap * leverage.

circuit_breaker.note: Halve position size for a symbol after 3 consecutive losses on that symbol, reset to full size on its next win. Validated across two different backtest windows (Jul1-Sep20 and Apr1-Jul15 2026) with a consistent Return/MaxDD improvement over flat sizing; exact threshold (3 vs 4 vs 5) not scientifically settled - see docs/decisions.md.
circuit_breaker.rejected_alternative: cross-symbol correlation cap (capping total simultaneous same-direction risk across symbols) - tested and NOT adopted, see docs/decisions.md
